sample_unit: pediatric hand radiographs (1425 RSNA internal test, 1202 DHA external test)
models_evaluated: RSNA 2017 Pediatric Bone Age Challenge winning deep learning model

links.outcome: Change in bone age prediction error under image transformations (rotation, flip, brightness, contrast, inversion, resolution)
links.effect: Significant MAD differences for all transformation groups except RSNA laterality marker (P=.86); clinically significant error proportions differed for 19 of 33 (57%) DHA transformations.
links.quote: There were significant differences in proportion of CSEs for 57% of the image transformations (19 of 33) performed on the DHA dataset.

links.outcome: Generalization of model performance from internal to external test set at baseline
links.effect: No evidence of MAD difference between baseline test sets (RSNA 6.8 months, DHA 6.9 months; P=.05), indicating good generalization to curated external images.
links.quote: There was no evidence of a difference in MAD of the model on the two baseline test sets (RSNA = 6.8 months, DHA = 6.9 months; P = .05), indicating good model generalization to external data.

unlisted_practices: Computational image-transformation stress testing of imaging AI for robustness to real-world appearance variation

screen.reason: Evaluates computational stress testing via synthetic image perturbations (rotations, brightness, markers, etc.) to assess model robustness and vulnerability to real-world image variation prior to deployment.
